name: Intolerance Religious
overview: Scripture reveals religious intolerance as a serious and often tragic reality, exemplified by Cain's violent rejection of his brother Abel (Genesis 4:8) and the strict commands against worshiping any god other than the LORD (Exodus 22:20). Even among Jesus' followers, intolerance appeared when John sought to forbid a man casting out demons in Jesus' name simply because he was not part of their group, but Jesus corrected this, affirming that miracles done in His name should not be hindered (Mark 9:38-39). These passages highlight both the dangers of divisive zeal and the call to recognize God's work beyond narrow boundaries.
